Name: James, Brother of Jesus
Summary: James, the brother of Jesus, did not believe during Jesus' ministry but became a pillar of the Jerusalem church after the resurrection. He presided at the Jerusalem Council and received Paul's report of his journeys.
KeyStory: James, once unbelieving, stood in Jerusalem and judged that Gentiles need not be circumcised to be saved.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Simon Peter; Paul; Mary, Mother of Jesus
LifeLesson: The brother who doubted became the brother who led. The resurrection changes families first.
